parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English

parameters.name: ExtGrayRules
parameters.description: Additional canary release rule list, when matching listeners, the additional canary release rules will be merged with existing rules for matching

sub_parameters.name: GrayRule
sub_parameters.description: The canary release rule. For a beta release, you can specify one or more client IP addresses for this parameter. You must separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). For a tag-based canary release, the value is in the format of Tag name=Tag value. You must separate multiple tag values with commas (,).

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The namespace ID. Default value: public

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: Parameter deprecated, no need to fill in
